paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.

model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates how the minimum ADE₂₀ metric, measured in meters, changes across different values of the ratio parameter, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, for five distinct methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and uses a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "minADE₂₀ (m)" and also uses a linear scale, spanning from approximately 0.55 to 0.78. The "TrajICL" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, remaining relatively flat around 0.60. The "Head Tuning" method is shown as an orange line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 0.78 and decreasing to about 0.69. The "FT" method is depicted by a green line with square markers, beginning at around 0.69 and steadily declining to approximately 0.53. The "LoRA 16" method is represented by a red line with diamond markers, starting near 0.74 and decreasing to about 0.60. The "LoRA 64" method is shown as a purple line with pentagon markers, starting at approximately 0.74 and decreasing to around 0.60. All lines show a general downward trend as the ratio increases, with the "FT" method showing the steepest decline.
model_annotations.German: This line chart illustrates how the minimum ADE₂₀ metric, measured in meters, changes across different values of the Ratio parameter, which represents the size of the in-context pool, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The x-axis is labeled “Ratio” and spans from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “minADE₂₀ (m)” and ranges from 0.55 to 0.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. Five distinct lines represent different methods: TrajICL (blue, circular markers, solid line), Head Tuning (orange, circular markers, solid line), FT (green, circular markers, solid line), LoRA 16 (red, circular markers, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple, circular markers, solid line). The TrajICL line remains relatively flat, starting at approximately 0.605 and ending at approximately 0.595. The Head Tuning line begins at approximately 0.785 and decreases steadily to approximately 0.695. The FT line starts at approximately 0.685 and decreases to approximately 0.525. The LoRA 16 line begins at approximately 0.735 and decreases to approximately 0.605. The LoRA 64 line starts at approximately 0.735 and decreases to approximately 0.605.
